scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Saturday's first-bay tire rotation and slow-leak check usable before the pickup's rural-route driving resumes.
Emerging Need: The service has not begun, but the shop's packet depends on a wheel-lock socket being confirmed in the truck before its Friday lock time.
Decision Context: The booking, payment hold, and precheck notices establish the slot and blank prerequisite; the pickup workpad supplies the locking-lug detail, socket location, desk route, and no-upgrade limits needed to choose a proportionate preparation step.
Consequence: Timely attention can preserve the early bay; after packet lock, the same socket information cannot recover that Saturday service.

parameter.subject: Saturday first-bay tire service notes
parameter.body: Prairie Rim Tire opened a limited set of Saturday first-bay rotation and slow-leak check slots. Vehicles with locking lug nuts need their wheel-lock socket confirmed in the vehicle before the service packet locks Friday afternoon; packets without required readiness notes may be moved to later standby handling.

parameter.description: Hold for Saturday pickup tire rotation and slow-leak check

parameter.title: Pickup tire rotation and slow-leak check
parameter.description: Prairie Rim Tire first-bay slot; drop pickup before rural route. Service packet readiness locks Friday at 16:00.

parameter.content: I got the Saturday early tire slot. Since I go straight to the route afterward, anything that has to be in the pickup needs to be there by Friday night; I won't have time to run back into the house Saturday morning.

parameter.subject: Precheck status for Saturday first-bay packet
parameter.body: Precheck for the Saturday 7:30 first-bay packet shows the wheel-lock socket confirmation field is still blank. Friday packet lock is 16:00. First-bay work on vehicles with locking lug nuts proceeds only when the socket is confirmed in the vehicle before packet lock; otherwise the bay is released to standby jobs.

parameter.subject: Saturday first-bay packet locked
parameter.body: Saturday first-bay packets locked at 16:00. The pickup packet for the Prairie Rim Tire hold still had no wheel-lock socket confirmation, so the 7:30 bay has been released to the standby list. The next no-charge rotation opening is Thursday, May 21.
